parsed.name: Agilent N9010A 频谱分析仪
parsed.description: Agilent N9010A 是一款射频频谱/信号分析仪，用于测量信号的频率分布、功率电平、带宽和峰值特征。它常用于射频与微波实验、电子测试、通信信号表征以及噪声与杂散分析。
parsed.description_en: The Agilent N9010A is an RF spectrum/signal analyzer used to measure signal frequency content, power level, bandwidth, and peak characteristics. It is commonly used in RF and microwave experiments, electronics testing, communication signal characterization, and noise or spurious analysis.
